summary.text: Gregory Rainville is a Democratic candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Franklin District, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He received the most votes in the August 11 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia's profile of Rainville says he earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Vermont in 1977 and a J.D. from the University of Toledo School of Law in 1980, and that he was admitted to the bar in 1981.

Ballotpedia lists his career as a litigation associate at Tyler, Bruce and Brooks from 1984 to 1995, an attorney at Rainville & Associates from 1995 to 2006, and a judge of the Vermont Superior Courts from 2006.

VTDigger reported in February 2023 that Superior Court Judge A. Gregory Rainville, appointed in 2006 by Governor James Douglas, withdrew his application for retention and chose to retire when his term concluded at the end of March; VTDigger's 2026 candidate list names A. Gregory Rainville as a Democratic, non-incumbent candidate for the Franklin District Senate seats.

sources.title: Superior Court judge to retire after questioning from lawmakers
